extraction.Name: Leon Roubideaux
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 10, 1918, by Walcott
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Nebraska State Bank of Valentine for $850 (mortgage satisfied April 15, 1918); land conveyed by deed to W. H. Tackett for $1500 on April 12, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612759 issued; Northwest quarter section 15, township 41, range 27; receipt signed by allottee but not dated; deed executed in favor of Nebraska State Bank of Rosebud, S.D. by Walcott; mortgage was in the nature of Valentine for $850, satisfied April 15, 1918
